# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — EL-G0 Data And Control Inventory Request r0.1

Status: **proposed human-mediated request; no Unity command or data transfer is
authorized by this file**

## Purpose

Gate D cannot be made exact from repository contents alone. A named human
custodian/operator must supply a timestamped, non-outcome inventory without
opening candidate, control, development, qualification, or challenge results.

## Historical-Control Artifact Inventory

For each potentially preserved historical executable/reduction family, supply:

- executable path label, SHA-256, size, and `--version` output;
- Citlali, kidscpp, and Tula exact revisions when available;
- compiler, C++ library, operating system/container/module identities and
  linked-library inventory;
- ordered config-source names, sizes, hashes, and merged-config hash;
- route/grouping/map/filter/stopping/learning configuration identity;
- raw input, APT, calibration, ephemeris, and geometry content IDs;
- runtime/threading provenance;
- output schema/product identities and checkpoint availability; and
- whether a small deterministic re-execution can be performed later on a
  development-only input.

Do not include scientific map values, fitted source quantities, iteration
metrics, or best-iteration conclusions.

## Population Inventory

Supply only counts and opaque lineage records using the schema in
`EL_G0_POPULATION_ACCESS_AND_LINEAGE_PLAN_R0.1.md`. Include explicit overlap
classification against all prior fruit-loop studies and Gate-0 Incident 001.
Do not reveal protected population membership or outcomes to the development
agent.

## Resource Inventory

Supply available compute classes, CPU/GPU identity, concurrency limits,
maximum job wall time/memory, storage quota, retention location, and named
human execution responsibility. Existing job outcomes or performance timings
are not requested at Gate 0.

## Transfer Record

Every supplied file requires timestamp, producing human, source scope, byte
count, SHA-256, field-level outcome-exclusion statement, and intended Gate-0
role. Any file containing outcomes is quarantined immediately and cannot be
silently relabeled as a non-outcome inventory.

Unity remains human-mediated. Codex must not connect, query, copy, or submit.
